g0: V3 AAHC per-scan maps and the exact optimized four-map group objective; original local GFP magnitude affects AAHC, each resulting axis is a unit vector

g1.objective: sum of weighted squared spatial projections, maximand
g1.peak_weights: within-scan uniform, sum to scan weight

s1.weights: per-scan GFP^2 / mean GFP^2 over all originally valid TR; uniform sensitivity
s1.lambda_scope: one shared value frozen from independent development simulations; no retuning on real cohorts or in bootstrap

time_windows.main: intersection of historical S0 windows for G0 and G1 in each scan; retain observed boundary pieces for both rules
time_windows.native: original cropped S0 and all valid TR for S1
time_windows.fd_censor: main less FD>0.50 mm and 1 preceding and 2 following frames, heldout-only mask used for both rules; templates unchanged
time_windows.edge: remove first/last observed runs for each retained block; descriptive

identification.within_v4: all pairwise matches and cycles for each state; fold 0 naming only
identification.legacy_v3: all heldout folds must have reliable and same V3 R or historical naming; do not equate IDs

quality_validation.disjoint: two whole training folds per bank within each outer split, common outer heldout scans; all three unordered training partitions
quality_validation.preferred_rule: see simulation_protocol.json; rank passing methods on disjoint label ARI then matched-map mean absolute r, with recovery loss reported

statistics.model: OLS condition + average FD, person clustered CR1 with finite-sample covariance factors and G-1 df
statistics.composition: ILR, half-TR pseudocount; restricted participant wild bootstrap, 9999 draws; no template retraining under null
statistics.adjustment: Holm 6 core slots per method, complete BH and Holm secondary families and across-method Holm

bootstrap.unit: stratified within original fold by HC/PD participants, patient visits together
